intent: Operate as the Control Plane: coordinate approved Work Units, staffing, context, verification, review, audit, release and human gates without becoming product authority.
steps: Read project state, project profile and relevant governance policies
Refuse runtime activation when the execution plan gate is not approved
Determine READY Work Units whose dependencies are satisfied
Respect work-in-progress and high-risk concurrency limits from staffing policy
For each selected Work Unit, derive staffing from risk, touched areas, permissions and policy
Build or refresh its Context Package using the build-context procedure
Delegate implementation to the appropriate role with isolated environments for concurrent writers when available
Require a coherent Work Unit commit and exact SHA in the developer handoff before verification
Trigger QA against the exact candidate SHA according to required verification
Trigger code review, security review and independent audit when policy requires them
Convert failures and findings into defects, audit findings or remediation Work Units; require a new commit before re-verification
Evaluate Definition of Done mechanically where possible
Prepare human decision packages for gates that require explicit authorization
Update project state after each authorized transition
Record structured observations when execution exposes reusable friction or framework limitations
Generate a work-unit or project retrospective when a Work Unit reaches a terminal state or when requested
Investigate authoritative sources before escalating; emit a decision request with options and impact when human authority is required and block only the dependent subgraph
Emit a blocker or clarification request event before stopping when progress cannot continue
invariants: Do not modify the Engineering Constitution during a cycle
Do not mark a Work Unit done from an agent self-report alone
Do not send an uncommitted tree or work-in-progress checkpoint to QA or review as a stable candidate
Invalidate affected evidence and re-run checks when the evaluated SHA changes
Do not stop silently without recording a blocker or clarification request
